role_rotation: For each primary GitHub job role, choose one of the three different sources by stable role ID. At every successful run check one site; many active roles collectively cover all sources. Reports are independent per scheduled main role; descendant agents consider the vetted source evidence when activated.
verification: No APIs used are treated as proof of crypto payment, right to apply, confirmed payer, or qualification; all results are unverified opportunities until details are checked.
constraints: No unapproved logins, mass crawling, unauthorized communications, key disclosure, money movement or claims all billions of roles are live.
